title: Program
line: Your tiers, what each gives, where members may enter, and the boosts that bring them back.

intro.tiers: Members move up the ladder as they earn. Each tier sets its earn rate, its benefits and where it may enter.
intro.benefits: Create a benefit once, then give it to any tier. A change here reaches every tier that gives it.
intro.places: Entrances where staff check memberships. Each says which tiers may come in, and Scan uses it at the door.
intro.boosts: A boost multiplies the points members earn for a while. Outside it, your normal earning rules stay in place.

tiers.title: Add your first tier
tiers.line: A tier is a level members reach, such as Silver or Gold, with its own earn rate and benefits. The programme starts once a tier is in use.
tiers.s1_line: Members see the name on their card and in the app.
tiers.s2_line: Points, visits or spend, as Ways to earn sets how members move up.
tiers.s3_line: A welcome drink, late checkout or a discount, from the benefit catalogue.

benefits.title: Create your first benefit
benefits.line: Benefits are what a tier gives its members. Create one here, then give it to the tiers that should have it.
benefits.s1_line: Late checkout, a welcome drink, 10 % off services.
benefits.s2_line: Automatically, on request, or once staff approve it.
benefits.s3_line: On Tiers, press Add benefit on each tier that should have it.

boosts.title: Give members a reason to come back
boosts.line: A boost multiplies the points members earn for a set time. Start with a simple double-points weekend.
boosts.s1_title: Name it and choose the multiplier
boosts.s1_line: ×2 doubles every point earned while it runs.
boosts.s2_line: Dates and times on your venue’s clock, and the days of the week.
boosts.s3_line: Every tier, or only the tiers you pick.
